scope: diagnostic pre-video only; not shipping final gate
phone_preview_provenance: Temporary snapshot rendered with generation/phone_previews.py render(folder,350), 10px bold screen font, GameCanvas x-4/y+3 offsets; not native UI screenshot.
inspection_method: Viewed updated unpainted and colored original artifacts and fresh 350px phone approximation; focused on prior defects and any new visual regressions. No UI played.
observations: Octopus with clear eyes and smile, eight arms, hat, star, seaweed and shell.
Revision5 retains 5 meaningful color groups and 5 numbered regions; small pieces retain source color as fixed artwork.
Fixed-color overlay matches colored original at inspected fixed pixels; original animal eyes/smile or object structure remain recognizable, with no added object face.
Small-label clearance is improved; remaining blocking findings are detailed below.
Four-connected map components each have one label; visual enclosure coverage assessed separately.

defects.description: Only 5 meaningful paintable color groups remain.
defects.action: Provide a sixth substantial paintable color with adequate space for a 10px screen label. Enlarge a suitable source-consistent region or add a broad colored panel; do not reinstate tiny mandatory fragments merely to increase the palette count.

limitations: Phone approximation uses PIL/Noto Sans rather than native Skia glyph metrics. No touch interaction tested.
Source/video gates are outside this diagnostic review.
